import tomllib,subprocess,shlex,json
from pathlib import Path
h=tomllib.loads((Path.home()/'.config/host-ops/config.toml').read_text())['hosts']['termux-phone']
script=r'''set -u
D="$HOME/Projects/PhotoMap/.dev/termux/import-pi-20261101-v1/data"
printf 'IDS='; id
printf 'RSYNC_LOCAL_DRYRUN='; rsync -ani /dev/null "$D/" 2>&1; echo "CODE=$?"
printf 'RSYNC_HOME_DRYRUN='; rsync -ani /dev/null "$HOME/" 2>&1; echo "CODE=$?"
printf 'RSYNC_PWD_DRYRUN='; cd "$D" && rsync -ani /dev/null ./ 2>&1; echo "CODE=$?"
printf 'BIN='; command -v rsync
printf 'FILE_SELINUX='; ls -Zd "$D" "$HOME" 2>/dev/null || true
'''
argv=['ssh','-i',str(Path(h['identity_file']).expanduser()),'-p',str(h['port']),'-o','IdentitiesOnly=yes','-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','StrictHostKeyChecking=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=8',str(h['user'])+'@'+str(h['host']),'bash -c '+shlex.quote(script)]
